text: Hey, quick question—if Legal needs People Ops to help with something like updating contracts for a specific country, is there a set process for how we’re supposed to request that? Or do we just email someone directly?

Yeah, there’s actually a template we’re supposed to use for that. It’s in the handbook somewhere—I think under the People Group section. Legal should fill it out with all the details (like what’s needed, any deadlines, who’s involved, etc) and then send it to People Ops. It helps make sure nothing gets missed.
Ah, got it. So not just a quick ping then. Do you know if we need to include stuff like translations or FAQs in the request?

Yep, if it’s relevant. Like, if there’s a language thing or if team members might have questions, you should mention if you need an FAQ or if People Ops has enough info to answer stuff. Basically, the more detail the better so they can handle it smoothly.
Makes sense, thanks Yuki! I’ll dig up the template and make sure we include everything.
